name: hacknation-template
description: Skrypty pomocnicze. Backend i frontend to osobne pakiety (własne package.json i bun.lock).

scripts.lint: bun --cwd=backend run lint && bun --cwd=frontend run lint
scripts.format: bun --cwd=backend run format && bun --cwd=frontend run format
scripts.format:check: bun --cwd=backend run format:check && bun --cwd=frontend run format:check
scripts.typecheck: bun --cwd=backend run typecheck && bun --cwd=frontend run typecheck
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check && bun run test:backend && bun run check:circular
